lines.text: After three days without water in the Desert of Shur, Moses threw a log into bitter water at Marah, and it became sweet.
At Elim the people camped by twelve springs and seventy palm trees, then in the Desert of Sin they grumbled against Moses and Aaron.
The glory of the LORD appeared in a fire, and that evening quail came and covered the camp.
Some people kept manna until morning and it filled with maggots, but on the seventh day the bread kept overnight stayed fresh.
Aaron placed a jar of manna in front of the Testimony, and the Israelites ate manna for forty years.
